players.product: high-layer-count and high-order HDI PCBs for AI servers / GPU boards, plus mSAP 800G / 1.6T optical-module PCBs

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026: revenue RMB 8.61 billion, +21.37% year on year; net profit attributable RMB 601.6 million, -7.38%, after an exchange loss of RMB 123 million from RMB appreciation (versus a gain of RMB 38 million a year earlier). Q2 2026 revenue RMB 4.72 billion, up more than 20% both year on year and quarter on quarter; Q2 net profit attributable RMB 369 million, +13.61% year on year and +58.55% quarter on quarter. Revenue growth was attributed to more orders; cost of sales rose 23.19% on sales growth and raw-material price increases.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 8,611.48 million (+21.37%); H1 net profit RMB 601.62 million (-7.38%); Q2 net profit +13.61% YoY, +58.55% QoQ

quarterly_data.signal: AI servers: the company supplied high-performance PCBs in volume to a leading global AI computing infrastructure customer (unnamed); as the customer's current-generation products enter volume delivery, related orders are growing rapidly and, based on the customer's delivery plan, are expected to fill the company's existing AI product factory, adding to results for the next several quarters. It has passed the customer's mass-production qualification for the next-generation product and is in early development of future products; it has also been certified by major domestic and overseas server and cloud-server makers and is gradually shipping in volume.

Optical modules: with new mSAP lines installed, the company delivered 800G and 1.6T optical-module PCBs in volume; in Q2 2026 revenue from optical-module PCBs for 800G and above grew nearly 1500% quarter on quarter. It supplies high-speed optical-module PCBs to several leading global customers (unnamed).
quarterly_data.figure: 800G-and-above optical-module PCB revenue up nearly 1500% QoQ in Q2 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: at the Zhuhai Jinwan base the high-order HDI factory is under construction and, at full output, is expected to provide 800,000 square metres of high-order HDI annual capacity for AI; 3 mSAP lines were built by end-June 2026, a 4th in August, and 5 lines will be in place within the year. The Thailand base will make 40+ layer ultra-high-layer boards, high-layer boards and HDI. Management: AI orders are ramping faster and larger than expected and existing plus under-construction capacity is expected to be unable to fully cover deliveries in the coming months, so a new AI capacity expansion is being evaluated. A RMB 5 billion Zhuhai Jinwan expansion was approved in August 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 3 mSAP lines at end-June 2026, a 4th in August, 5 within the year

quarterly_data.signal: Management: AI build-outs have concentrated demand on PCB raw materials (copper-clad laminate, prepreg, copper foil); supply is tight, prices keep rising and this is not expected to fundamentally improve in the short term, partly because of a structural supply-demand imbalance from upstream electronic glass-fabric capacity shifting. Kinwong is passing costs through to customers and locking in supplier capacity; automotive PCB profitability had clearly recovered by June 2026.

Products: GPU high-order HDI boards, 800G/1.6T optical-module PCBs, Birchstream-platform server high-speed PCBs, 112G switch PCBs and AI 224G switch PCBs reached mass production; pre-research covers 100+ layer boards, 11-order 26-layer HDI and M9+/PTFE materials for next-generation AI servers, switches, NPO, CPO and CPC.

Kinwong.why: PCB maker supplying high-layer / high-order HDI boards for AI servers and GPU boards and mSAP optical-module PCBs; AI server and optics builds drive its orders and capacity expansion.
Kinwong.evidence: Kinwong 2026 half-year report: supplies high-performance PCBs in volume to a leading global AI computing infrastructure customer; 800G/1.6T optical-module PCBs delivered in volume.
